metadata.title: Secure Time

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for asserting that time-dependent trust decisions are supported by authoritative, consistent, and defensible time.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Composite trust assertion aggregating platform time capabilities to support secure, time-dependent trust decisions.

metadata.remarks: Secure Time is a composite trust assertion stating that time used for authentication, authorization, auditing, correlation, and enforcement is authoritative, bounded, observable, and resilient. It introduces no independent controls and exists solely as an aggregate trust claim.

components.title: Platform Time Core
components.description: Baseline trust assumptions for time as a governed platform service.

components.title: Time Synchronization and Sources
components.description: Acquisition and synchronization of time from authoritative sources.

components.title: Time Drift and Correction
components.description: Detection, bounding, and correction of time skew.

components.title: Time Availability and Resilience
components.description: Redundancy, failover, and predictable behavior under failure.

components.title: Time Observability and Telemetry
components.description: Visibility into time behavior to support monitoring and investigation.
